description_en: Pushes order events from the service provider to the Zhongzhou platform. Events are of two types: notification events and status transition events. The latter triggers the order state machine on the Zhongzhou platform
description_zh: 服务商通过此接口将事件推送至中洲平台，事件有两种类型：通知事件、状态流转事件，后者会触发中洲平台订单状态机的状态流转
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen cooperator-hotel-event-push --order-id 123456 --cooperator-order-id coop_123456 --event-time 204-09-01_10:55:20 --event USER_LEAVE --event-desc '用户离店' --change-order-status 11 --change-order-status-desc '交易成功' --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CooperatorHotelEventPush

parameters.help_en: The order ID on the Zhongzhou platform
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The order ID of the service provider
parameters.name: cooperator_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The time when the event occurred.

Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh:
事件发生的时间

格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: event_time

parameters.help_en: The order status after the change. Leave empty unless a special scenario applies
parameters.help_zh: 变更后的订单状态-非特殊场景不填
parameters.name: change_order_status

parameters.help_en: The description of the order status after the change
parameters.help_zh: 变更后的订单状态描述
parameters.name: change_order_status_desc
